ruleName: Penalty area – Ball lost or not out
title: What happens if you hit your ball into the water again from a penalty area?
question: You play from a penalty area and your ball is lost or goes straight into the water in the penalty area. What should you do?

choices.text: Drop a new ball outside the penalty area with no penalty
Proceed under the penalty area rules with a one-stroke penalty
Play your next shot from the water with no penalty
Replay the shot but add two penalty strokes

explanation: You must use the penalty area relief options and take a one-stroke penalty.
